title: Why does search miss the cache?

scenes.title: Intro
beats: Search answers slowly, even for the same query twice.
We will follow one request, a search for nile, through the CDN.

scenes.title: The miss
beats: The browser sends the query with a timestamp.
The CDN builds its cache key from the full URL.
The timestamp changes every second, so every key is new, and every request is a miss.

scenes.title: The fix
beats: The fix drops the timestamp from the cache key.
The second search for nile now hits the cache. The answer time goes from eight hundred forty milliseconds to twelve.
